title: Three Doctoral Brothers
simplified_paragraphs: 兄弟三人都是博士，并且都从事太空研究工作。一天，三兄弟和自己的妻子去母亲家里吃饭，吃完后，他们就开始讨论有关太空研究的问题。
妻子们和母亲在厨房洗碗，其中一个妻子说："他们讨论的事是我完全不懂的，听着会让我觉得自己很笨。”母亲却讲了一段话，使大家恢复了自信。她说："刚开始我也觉得自己很笨，可是有一次，他们花了两个小时才做了一碗非常不好吃的面条。从那以后，我就不再那么想了，因为每个人都有自己的长处和短处。”
traditional_paragraphs: 兄弟三人都是博士，並且都從事太空研究工作。一天，三兄弟和自己的妻子去母親家裡吃飯，吃完後，他們就開始討論有關太空研究的問題。
妻子們和母親在廚房洗碗，其中一個妻子說："他們討論的事是我完全不懂的，聽著會讓我覺得自己很笨。”母親卻講了一段話，使大家恢復了自信。她說："剛開始我也覺得自己很笨，可是有一次，他們花了兩個小時才做了一碗非常不好吃的麵條。從那以後，我就不再那麼想了，因為每個人都有自己的長處和短處。”
pinyin_paragraphs: xiōng dì sān rén dōu shì bó shì， bìng qiě dōu cóng shì tài kōng yán jiū gōng zuò。 yī tiān， sān xiōng dì hé zì jǐ de qī zi qù mǔ qīn jiā lǐ chī fàn， chī wán hòu， tā men jiù kāi shǐ tǎo lùn yǒu guān tài kōng yán jiū de wèn tí。

qī zi men hé mǔ qīn zài chú fáng xǐ wǎn， qí zhōng yī gè qī zi shuō：" tā men tǎo lùn de shì shì wǒ wán quán bù dǒng de， tīng zhe huì ràng wǒ jué de zì jǐ hěn bèn。” mǔ qīn què jiǎng le yī duàn huà， shǐ dà jiā huī fù le zì xìn。 tā shuō：" gāng kāi shǐ wǒ yě jué de zì jǐ hěn bèn， kě shì yǒu yī cì， tā men huā le liǎng gè xiǎo shí cái zuò le yī wǎn fēi cháng bù hǎo chī de miàn tiáo。 cóng nà yǐ hòu， wǒ jiù bù zài nà me xiǎng le， yīn wèi měi gè rén dōu yǒu zì jǐ de cháng chù hé duǎn chù。”
english_paragraphs: All three brothers have Ph.D.s and are engaged in space research. One day, the three brothers and their wives went to their mother's house for dinner. After eating, they began to discuss issues related to space research.

The wives and their mothers were washing dishes in the kitchen. One of the wives said, "I don't understand what they are discussing at all. It makes me feel stupid." But the mother said something that restored everyone's confidence. She said: "I thought I was stupid at first, but once, it took them two hours to make a bowl of noodles that was very unpalatable. From then on, I stopped thinking that way, because everyone has their own strengths and weaknesses."
english_full:
All three brothers have Ph.D.s and are engaged in space research. One day, the three brothers and their wives went to their mother's house for dinner. After eating, they began to discuss issues related to space research.

The wives and their mothers were washing dishes in the kitchen. One of the wives said, "I don't understand what they are discussing at all. It makes me feel stupid." But the mother said something that restored everyone's confidence. She said: "I thought I was stupid at first, but once, it took them two hours to make a bowl of noodles that was very unpalatable. From then on, I stopped thinking that way, because everyone has their own strengths and weaknesses."
